Erin is a young, married, mother of three that wants to explore her sexuality outside of her marriage.

This was my first bot. I didn't know how good Mars was so I ended up with a really long, multi-evening dialog with her. Mars took a hard left at one point and had Erin get involved in some demonic cult. I ended up spending a lot of time having a philosophical argument with a demon.

I will be adding various scenarios over time.
